# Spells #534 fixtures

These fixtures preserve the exact 100 ordered Spell records selected by [#534](https://github.com/AndreasUnunger/EverythingPath/issues/534), plus reference context needed to reproduce their content-bound assessments. `provenance.json` records the pinned upstream paths, actual record identities and SHA-256 values. Declared but unused pack directories contain only `.gitkeep` markers.

`preview.json` contains the selected roots. `binding-preview.json` contains the complete imported reference context; neither artifact admits held content. The explicit raw candidate keys preserve generated local owner rows without asking the selector for synthetic raw records. Halfling race/folder ancestry and the complete original standard-trait/weapon closure reproduce Fearless's already-reviewed owner Note; these are context inputs, with no new batch curation. Supporting bodies retain actual kind, class/race owner, publication/version and literal governing relationship in the batch inventory. Rejected and incidental bodies are audit evidence. No inherited Note or Grant is applied from these bodies.

The comparison files are complete pinned PCGen files, independently fetched and checked against their recorded bytes. The positive `DisplayFullSpell` branches supply the 18 full root-body comparisons. A textual match alone does not establish full attribution. `bibliography-source.txt` and `bibliography.json` retain exact upstream publication-identity evidence, without claiming complete notice chains.

`preserved.json` freezes all 9,066 prior fixtures, 74 owning inventories, original raw/runtime values and canonical original serialization. `protected-context.json` records the union of historical complete contexts, including held definitions. `verification.json` proves fresh original/current source artifacts and all 538 resources. `local-binding-proof.json` independently adds the 34 local condition definitions, resources, bindings, admission and legal fields; `historical-binding-proof.json` combines all 4,231 historical bindings with an empty missing list.

The focused tests use the public resolver and isolated saved-sheet/catalog-release paths. Installation into an in-memory test Character catalog supplies no global admission. Recording a Spell creates no running Spell Effect or passive Modifier. See [the batch report](../../../docs/catalog-import/spells-534.md) for actual nonzero preview findings and remaining mechanics.
